cast/double/malformed-string.reason: SQL CAST reads a numeric prefix where CEL requires the whole string and raises otherwise, so double() over a string column is refused rather than lowered to CAST.

cast/double/negated-malformed-string.reason: The Criteria API has no portable CEL numeric parsing expression that preserves conversion errors under negation.

cast/int/malformed-string.reason: SQL CAST reads a numeric prefix where CEL requires the whole string and raises otherwise, so int() over a string column is refused rather than lowered to CAST.

cast/int/negated-malformed-string.reason: The Criteria API has no portable CEL numeric parsing expression that preserves conversion errors under negation.

cast/int/negative-fraction.reason: int() over a double truncates toward zero in CEL, while PostgreSQL and MySQL CAST round to nearest, so the cast is refused rather than lowered to CAST.

cast/timestamp/malformed-string.reason: timestamp() over createdBy, which is mapped to a String column: a String does not pin an absolute instant, and a malformed value must stay a CEL error, which no SQL cast preserves, so the adapter refuses to compare it.

cast/timestamp/negated-malformed-string.reason: createdBy is stored as a String; timestamp comparisons require an absolute-instant Java column type, rather than lexicographic string ordering or database-specific parsing.

collection/except/as-whole-condition.reason: except is not supported: Cerbos except(list, list) computes a list difference, which has no JPA Criteria translation. Rewrite the policy with a collection macro instead — e.g. size(R.attr.tags.except(["x"])) > 0 is equivalent to R.attr.tags.exists(t, !(t in ["x"])).

collection/filter/as-conjunct.reason: filter() returns a list, not a boolean; only size(filter(...)) has a Criteria meaning, so a filter() conjunct is refused rather than dropped (dropping it would over-grant).

collection/filter/as-whole-condition.reason: filter() returns a list, not a boolean; only size(filter(...)) has a Criteria meaning, so a bare filter() in boolean position is refused.

collection/map/as-whole-condition.reason: map() translates only as the collection operand of hasIntersection; used as the whole condition it is a list, not a boolean, and is refused.

regex/matches/anchored-prefix.reason: JPA Criteria has no regular-expression predicate, so matches() is refused.

regex/matches/compared-to-true.reason: The Criteria API has no portable RE2 regular expression predicate.

regex/matches/end-anchor-before-final-ne.reason: The Criteria API has no portable RE2 regular expression predicate.

regex/matches/lookahead-from-principal.reason: The Criteria API has no portable RE2 regular expression predicate.

regex/matches/top-level-alternation-pref.reason: JPA Criteria has no regular-expression predicate, so matches() is refused.

timestamp/equals/field-to-field-without-.reason: Bare temporal comparison cannot preserve CEL string equality; use timestamp() explicitly
